text: Greenwashing is when a company makes a claim about its environmental impact that is either ____ or simply false.
They say one thing but do another.
My favorite case is hotels. If you go to a hotel, you will most likely see an invitation to reduce towel usage in order to save water.
They promote saving soap and water, but at the same time, you will probably enter your room and find the air-conditioning running 24 hours a day.
TerraChoice, an environmental NGO, identified what they call the 'Seven Sins of Greenwashing.'
Perhaps the most ____ one is the 'Sin of Hidden Trade-Off,' where a company ____ one minor environmental action while hiding or failing to ____ the true impact of its service or product.
The number of trademarks including the words 'eco-friendly' or 'green' has grown significantly.
At the same time, public awareness has also increased.
People are becoming more concerned about the food they eat, the air they breathe, and the water they drink.
This concern has evolved into a social movement, leading to a rise in environmental NGOs acting as watchdogs for firms.
The message is clear: be careful about greenwashing.
The consequences, both in terms of reputation and economic impact, can be severe.
